seed_strategy.rule: independent initialization seeds are the statistical units

stopping_rule: execute every declared condition for every declared seed; retain failures and null results
inclusion_criteria: all preregistered conditions execute without target leakage
all numeric outputs are finite where defined
source revision and protocol hashes are retained
exclusion_criteria: target leakage into the evaluation path
condition budget mismatch where budget matching is a protocol requirement

s6_epi_001_v1.success_direction: intact recall should exceed lesion/shuffle controls without payload access

s6_sem_001_v1.success_direction: held-out intact generalization should exceed shuffled/no-semantic controls

s6_rpl_001_v1.success_direction: ordered replay requires benefit beyond no-replay and equal-budget awake controls for a strong consolidation claim

s6_pe_001_v1.success_direction: prediction-error effects must remain separable from reward calls

s6_wm_001_v1.success_direction: frozen correct model should outperform shuffled and persistence references on held-out rollouts

s6_wm_002_v1.success_direction: correct frozen model recommendations should improve offline utility without actuation authority
